locked_story.headline: Twelve days before the handoff: Governor-elect Kreiss-Tomkins asks AIDEA to pause until he takes office December 7th, AIDEA's director signals no pause and the recessed board meeting resumes November 27th, while the state's data center push (the AIDEA-owned Alaska Data Corp and the 6,800-acre Houston parcel AIDEA lists for possible scalable data centers) runs into a Mat-Su Borough reconsideration request due November 30th whose 30-day DNR answer would land under the new governor
locked_story.note: Four researchers called it a slow week. No in-window Alaska story had ML as its subject and was not already covered or in the archive (USGS tephra ML is in dispatch_history; Waymo Fairbanks covered 11-11). Follow-up rung: a genuinely new development (the pause request, AIDEA's answer, DNR's November 10th final decision cut to about 6,800 acres, the borough's November 17th reversal request) on covered subjects (10-20 Houston preliminary decision, 36 days ago; 11-13 Alaska Data Corp tokenization; 10-26 candidates on data centers). dedupe.py flagged token overlaps (kreiss/tomkins with 10-26; aidea/december with 10-31). Judged distinct subject: the transition's control of the state data center push, not any one AIDEA deal. Thesis must not repeat the blank-fields angle of 10-29, 10-31 and 10-20.

rungs.note: 4 researchers (science/agencies, energy/policy, fisheries/health/rural, defense/wildcard), 78 of 80 WebSearch calls used, about 150 uncapped WebFetches. All four called it a slow week.
Covered inside round one: ADN, Alaska Beacon, Alaska Public, KTOO, KDLL, News-Miner, KTUU, KYUK, KNOM, KUCB, Arctic Today, Must Read Alaska indexes read.
AIDEA pause request plus Houston reconsideration; Waymo DOT permit (rejected, 11-11 inside 30 days).
